recorded.prompt:q-model: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-model: "It gives every stop one decision variable, its successor", then "local search". "The answer is a good set of routes, not one with a proof of optimality."
recorded.prompt:q-indices: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-indices: "the ends come after them, one per vehicle" and "Index 5 or 6 or 7 used as a row of a 5-row matrix is off the end". With 6 nodes, the ends are indices 7 and 8.

recorded.outcome:q-scaling: "multiply by a scale that keeps the precision you care about, round, and divide the objective by the same scale when you report it."

recorded.prompt:q-model:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-model:a: "The routing library never writes them: its successor variables and path constraints keep each route connected".
recorded.prompt:q-model:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-model:c: "not one with a proof of optimality. A MIP solver reports a bound and a gap; the routing library reports neither."
recorded.prompt:q-model:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-model:d: The library uses successor variables, not the pair binaries. Its path constraints, not local search alone, keep routes free of subtours.
recorded.prompt:q-indices:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:a: The ends are separate indices numbered after Size(), e.g. 6 and 7 for 5 nodes. They map to node 0 only through IndexToNode.
recorded.prompt:q-indices:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:b: "With two vehicles, indices 5, 6 and 7 are all node 0."
recorded.prompt:q-indices:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:c: "the start of vehicle 0, the start of vehicle 1, the end of vehicle 0 and the end of vehicle 1, four different indices".
recorded.prompt:q-scaling:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scaling:b: "A float return does not get rounded for you: the solve fails" (SystemError).
recorded.prompt:q-scaling:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scaling:c: The guide "truncates with int() ... rounding can change the answer in other cases; this is one of them". Whole minutes gave a longer tour.
recorded.prompt:q-scaling:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scaling:d: Costs are 64-bit integers, and tenths of a minute (scale 10) worked and found a truly shorter tour. Finer units are recommended, not an overflow risk.
